newsitem.title: USA: Colombia's Ecopetrol awards end-June Cusiana cargo.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol awards end-June Cusiana cargo.

text.p: Colombia's state-owned oil company Ecopetrol late last week awarded a cargo of light sweet Colombian Cusiana crude oil for end-June loading, trading sources said.

The buyer was said to be a major East Coast-based independent refiner, and closed in a range between $1.20 to $1.23 a barrel discount to July West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on an fob basis, sources said.
Neither Ecopetrol nor the independent refiner could be immediately reached to confirm or deny the sale of the Cusiana, which yields relatively high amounts of gasoline.
Traders also said British Petroleum sold a cargo for June 21-22 loading of Cusiana crude on Monday to another independent refiner at either a $1.22 or $1.23 a barrel discount to July WTI/Cushing.

The placement of the BP and Ecopetrol cargoes takes care of half the June Cusiana loading program, leaving outastanding one more Ecopetrol cargo for June 14-18 loading and one Total cargo for end June-early July loading.
